subject.title: msteams: support Copilot-only streaming without enabling Teams DM streaming

question: Should the Microsoft Teams plugin add an additive Copilot-specific streaming configuration, and which stable key shape plus surface-detection contract should it use?
rationale: The source limitation is clear, but the implementation adds persistent channel config and depends on Microsoft 365 Copilot activity metadata that is not proven by a live sample in this repository.

options.title: Approve additive Copilot config after live sample
options.body: Capture a redacted Copilot custom-engine activity sample, then add a plugin-owned additive config key with explicit precedence over the existing global `channels.msteams.streaming`.

options.title: Keep one global streaming mode
options.body: Decline the per-surface split for now and document that Teams and Copilot share the same global Microsoft Teams streaming mode.

options.title: Defer until Microsoft metadata is clearer
options.body: Keep this issue open but block implementation until the detector can be specified from reliable Microsoft activity metadata.

recommendation.title: Approve additive Copilot config after live sample
recommendation.body: Capture a redacted Copilot custom-engine activity sample, then add a plugin-owned additive config key with explicit precedence over the existing global `channels.msteams.streaming`.

likelyOwner.reason: BradGroux has adjacent msteams config history and maintains the Microsoft tracker that references this issue, while the final choice still needs maintainer product approval.
